topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't stop thinking about it. Every day, I see him leave for what I always thought was just another humdrum office job, but now I know. The rumors at the coffee shop were whispers, just faint enough to be ignored, but they lingered. And then, a glimpse through the wrong window at the wrong time—a car, sleek and black, idling at his curb, the kind that shouldn’t belong in our quiet street. My chest tightens. How long has this been going on? What else don’t I know? Each day now, I watch, restless, wondering what other secrets the houses around me keep.
